canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: not found (Issue missing or comment ID missing or role zero vs expected)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: CONTROL_ROLE_MISSING or PLAN_MISSING or NOT_FOUND -> mapped to FAILED_NO_EFFECT or BLOCKED / NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE depending on whether missing is precondition or operation scope; no mutation attempted; read-before-write fails closed
canonical_mapping.notes: Missing required control role (count 0) -> CONTROL_ROLE_MISSING fail closed; Issue missing -> PLAN_MISSING; never invents body

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: duplicate control role (>1 binding for canonical role)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: CONTROL_ROLE_DUPLICATE -> CONFLICT / FAILED_NO_EFFECT (no heuristic selection); deterministic fail closed
canonical_mapping.notes: Count>1 must not silently select newest/latest; surface CONFLICT for M4-7 reconciliation

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: stale raw authority precondition (revision or digest mismatch at pre-read or mutate-time rejection)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: STALE_AUTHORITY -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT (stale fails closed; no last-write-wins; no blind overwrite)
canonical_mapping.notes: Preserves SUBJECT_REVISION != RAW twist; normalized digest not involved

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: authorization mismatch (principal lacks permission for Issue/comment; token lacks repo scope)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: UNAUTHORIZED / FORBIDDEN -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT or BLOCKED with explicit AUTHORIZATION_MISMATCH; no retry without fresh authorization and new lease
canonical_mapping.notes: Different from transient; not retried automatically; fresh semantic authorization required

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: known transport no-effect (explicit API rejection proving no effect, e.g., 422 with stale precondition error body)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: FAILED_NO_EFFECT (known no-effect failure, proven no side effect)
canonical_mapping.notes: Distinguishable from OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; adapter must inspect error body to prove no effect before claiming no-effect

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: unknown outcome (request timeout, connection reset, API response lost, write may have happened but unavailable, post-write readback unavailable)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN -> RECONCILING handoff to M4-7; is not success, not failure, not retry permission; no blind retry, no old lease reuse
canonical_mapping.notes: Must surface typed observation with OUTCOME_UNKNOWN outcome enum; verification readback will reconcile

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: verify mismatch (transport success but readback original observed or third-state observed)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: If original -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT (with fresh auth); if third -> CONFLICT (needs semantic choice); transport success alone never VERIFIED
canonical_mapping.notes: VERIFY_AFTER_WRITE distinguishes; candidate original third mapped via three-way classifier

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: third-state conflict (readback third raw digest differing from both original and candidate)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: CONFLICT -> RECONCILING -> CONFLICT terminal (needs semantic choice; no heuristic overwrite or silent rebase)
canonical_mapping.notes: Preserves M4-0 D3 J7; normalized equality supporting-only

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: permission/auth failure (401/403 with missing scopes / expired token)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: AUTH_FAILURE -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT / BLOCKED with distinct error code; preflight gh api user check should catch before mutate where possible
canonical_mapping.notes: Separate from rate-limit transient; never retried without credential fix

canonical_mapping.github_specific_failure: rate-limit / transient transport condition (429 / 5xx / network transient where no authority effect can be proven)
canonical_mapping.canonical_category: TRANSIENT_TRANSPORT -> OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT depending on whether readback proves original; must distinguish from known no-effect; no blind reuse
canonical_mapping.notes: Rate-limit that provably had no effect may map to FAILED_NO_EFFECT; otherwise OUTCOME_UNKNOWN if uncertainty remains
